notes: Governmental funds modified cash basis (pp4-5), business-type accrual (proprietary statements pp6-7), so business_type measure is net position from p7 (as FY2023/FY2024). Proprietary statement of cash flows (p8) printed but proprietary left null as in the later years. Governmental roll-forward uses fund balances (p5): 755,184 + 2,521,091 - 1,169,172 + 280,000 = 2,387,103. Transfers: Total column prints net transfers in 280,000 (General 298,020 in, Keno 18,020 out); recorded as printed in transfers_in. ending_cash = governmental funds balance sheet total assets 2,387,455 (p4; all cash lines incl. restricted and county treasurer cash; liabilities are payroll withholdings 352); beginning cash not printed. Bond proceeds 1,250,000 and sale of assets 4,141 are printed among revenues and inside total revenues, so they are receipt lines. Business-type: other revenue 3,201 is counted in charges for services on the Statement of Activities (p2: 336,246); grant income 76,282 (no grantor printed) category other; no single printed totals (operating + nonoperating added); transfers to other funds (280,000) in transfers_net; 2,530,815 + 418,544 - 445,029 - 280,000 = 2,224,330. Component unit (Osmond Library Foundation) excluded. Detail: General Fund from the departmental combining schedule (pp14-15, more detailed than the General Fund budget schedule p9, which is therefore not recorded); Street, Sales Tax and Keno budget schedules (pp10-12; lines with no actual amount, e.g. Street motor vehicle and contributions budgets, Keno community betterment budget 10,000, not recorded); nonmajor combining statement (p13); proprietary funds have no budget schedule, so no business-type detail (as FY2023). 'Contributions and grants' recorded as donations/contributions (mixed label naming contributions; grantor not printed). Read pages 1-15 of 15
